# Runtime validation fixtures

Original synthetic fixtures, CC0-1.0. No health records or real identifiers.
`source.json` is the independently written source. `candidate-bundle.json`
retains its decimal scale/comparator/month date. Its asset URL is filled with
the actual retained source digest by the test, never a fabricated hash.
[Expected facts](../../expected/validation-facts.json) are hand-authored from
that source, not generated by an importer. Wrong-person, unresolved/contradictory
source, malformed schema/evidence and prepared-byte cases mutate copies.

The separate [profile corpus](../profiles/) remains owned by the profiles worker.
Runtime tests also exercise its independently authored expected clinical facts;
its placeholder assets/evidence alone never establish an acceptable proposal.
